body:
# Consensus-layer Call 139

[prev: call 138](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1100)

Meeting Date/Time: [Thursday 2024/8/8 at 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/aug-8-2024/2pm)
Meeting Duration: 1.5 hours
[stream](https://youtube.com/live/o8p47gIt7Bs?feature=share)

1. Electra
    * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3853 alpha.4 soon!
    * devnet-2
    * Using mempool for blob distribution
        * `engine_getBlobsV1`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/559
        * P2P clarification: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3864
     * mplex deprecation: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3866
     * EIP-7688 SSZ StableContainer inclusion in Pectra
2. PeerDAS
    * any development updates?
    * PeerDAS without sampling PR: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3870
3. Research, spec, etc
    * [consolidations and sync committees](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1116#issuecomment-2275697028)
    * Add `quic` ENR entry: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3644
    * ProbeLab update
4. Open discussion/Closing remarks

comments.body: I would like to present ProbeLab's [weekly reports](https://probelab.io/ethereum/discv5/2024-29/), providing measurements on Beacon nodes participating in `discv5`. I will explain the methodology, show the plots and discuss key results. We would appreciate your feedback and improvement suggestions.

On #1104, we agreed to make a final decision about https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/559 on the next ACDC, pending a PR to specify the expect "honest validator" usage of the new endpoint.

We just wanted to bring up mplex deprecation again. It's becoming a bit of a liability. We are thinking of setting a date in the near future, where Lighthouse will remove support for it. We want to make this date reasonable so that it doesn't impact other clients that may still depend on it. 

There is a PR to comment on this here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3866
Bringing back QUIC PR into discussion https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3644

@ralexstokes Teku team is mostly away this week. I am not sure if we will have anyone at the call (I won't be awake for it). I'm gonna drop some comments/notes here:
- **devnet-2**: Teku seems to be holding up well so far. We haven't heard of any recent issues with Teku. Please ping me on Discord if you find anything weird we are doing or if you have any concerns.
- **engine_getBloblsV1**: nothing controversial from our point-of-view (assuming that @tbenr 's concerns https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3864 have been considered valid and we all agree on it).
- **PeerDAS**: I don't have a lot to update. Last I spoke with Dmitrii, we were preparing for a devnet-1 relaunch next week. We have some work to do on Megadata V3 as well.
- **MPLEX deprecation**: In Teku, we have made some progress with Yamux, it is in an experimental phase atm. We should be able to prioritize it and make it the new standard in the near (not so near) future. @AgeManning what timeframe are you guys working on for deprecation?

I think that's the gist of it. Maybe we get lucky and someone from Teku joins the call. But at least you guys have a rough idea of what's going on with Teku :)

I'll catch up with the recording tomorrow and follow-up on any questions and/or actions from the meeting. Cheers!

- EIP-7688 SSZ `StableContainer` - last ACDC the sentiment I got was that the feature is generally seen useful, but there were prioritization concerns given the EL instabilities back then at devnet 2, and that some team members working on peerDAS may not leave enough time for 7688. Can we assess this more cleanly now (for devnet 3)?
  - Rocket Pool statement: https://x.com/KaneWallmann/status/1816729724145795258 ([alternative without X login](https://nitter.lucabased.xyz/KaneWallmann/status/1816729724145795258))
  - consensus-spec-tests updated to include SSZ data structure tests: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3844#issuecomment-2239285376
  - For Pectra, the proposed SSZ scope is only EIP-7688 stable generalized indices; not SSZ transactions and other ideas (ELs are not ready at this time, besides Ethereumjs that has an SSZ transaction devnet available)
- Consolidations: What happens when the consolidation source is part of current / next sync committee? Should the consolidation be delayed until pending validator duties are fulfilled? Should the protocol prevent validators from getting new duties beyond any pending consolidations and exits?

- Validator operation requests: Should we group the various validator request fields within a sub-`Container` to match the EL design with a `requests_root` more closely, and also to be able to group the various requests if there actually is a new one at some future time? see https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/565#issuecomment-2269347854
Quick question, should we bring back testing call that we used to have during deneb/merge days?
Could we circle back to discussing https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3800 ?
